y = -2x - 10

What is the x-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = -2x - 10
y = 5x - 3
problem.question: What is the x-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 -2x - 10 = 5x - 3이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (-7)x = 7이므로 x = 7 ÷ (-7) = -1이다. 이를 y = -2x - 10에 대입하면 y = -2 × -1 - 10 = -8이다. 따라서 x좌표는 -1이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, -2x - 10 = 5x - 3. Rearranging gives (-7)x = 7, so x = 7 ÷ (-7) = -1. Substituting into y = -2x - 10 gives y = -2 × -1 - 10 = -8. So the x-coordinate is -1.
